changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0039. A gym customer can exist without a LifeFit login. Copy the current account name onto the member profile, then allow MemberProfiles.UserId to be null. Index review: drop UX_MemberProfiles_TenantId_UserId before the column becomes nullable, then recreate it filtered to rows that have a user so two customers without a login are allowed and one login still maps to one profile. No new name index; member search stays on IX_MemberProfiles_TenantId_Status. Performance note: the backfill updates existing member rows by their user foreign key.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE app.MemberProfiles ADD FirstName NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_MemberProfiles_FirstName DEFAULT N'', LastName NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_MemberProfiles_LastName DEFAULT N'', Phone NVARCHAR(32) NULL;
